FQ228.question: How many presidents has Peru had in the last 5 years?

claims.snippet: José Jerí became the most recent president to be removed from office on February 17—just four months into his term—over corruption allegations.

claims.snippet: Balcázar, from the left-wing Free Peru party, is the eighth president to govern Peru since 2016, with several previous leaders also deposed by Congress.

claims.snippet: August 22, 1968. Abbey Road Studios, London. Ringo Starr walks into Studio 2 for another White Album session feeling like he’s the worst drummer in the world.

claims.claim: Ringo Starr returned to The Beatles on September 3, 1968.
claims.snippet: When Ringo returned to Abbey Road on September 3rd, he found his drum kit completely covered in flowers.

claims.claim: George Harrison arranged for Ringo's drum kit to be covered in flowers as a welcome-back gesture.
claims.snippet: George had arranged it as a welcome-back gesture. The studio was covered in flowers—on the drums, on the amps, on the piano, everywhere. It was George’s idea.
